title: At Risk customer's 12-month revenue link opens the Sales report for that customer
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin with the Reports permission.
A test-created customer has exactly one invoiced Work Order with a large labour total (about $1,000,000), invoiced about 90 days ago, and nothing since (seeded via API).
Browser storage holds no remembered At Risk window and no remembered expanded tile.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the Dashboard and click "View details" on the At Risk Customers tile.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The At Risk Customers table is shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: Change the inactivity window to "60 days".
custom_steps_separated.expected: The seeded customer is listed, with its 12-month revenue shown as a link.

custom_steps_separated.content: Click the seeded customer's 12-month revenue amount.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Sales report opens in the same tab. Its URL carries the seeded customer and a custom date range from the 1st of the month eleven months ago to today (shop's local date).

custom_steps_separated.content: Wait for the Sales table to load.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The customer filter chip shows the seeded customer, the seeded invoice is listed as a row, and every row belongs to that customer.
